dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY replacing, LINKAGE SECTION parameters, grpsys-prefixed lines, and COMMON-SPA copybook typical of the ORCA system

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - monthly billing/receipt aggregation for social insurance and public expense claims (医科・入院外)
purpose.summary: ORCBM032 is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that generates monthly receipt claim reports for medical insurance (社保・診療報酬請求書, 医科・入院外). It retrieves hospital/facility information, processes summary tables of treatment counts, days, and fees by insurance category, and formats print output for submission to insurers.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (SUM-AREA, WRK-PARA, SPA-AREA)
Large OCCURS tables for insurance summary aggregation (SUM-TABLE-OCC OCCURS 100, nested OCCURS)
24 COPY statements for modular copybook inclusion
Japanese text in comments and string literals (latin-1 encoded Shift-JIS/EUC-JP mojibake)
grpsys-prefixed lines indicating group/system conditional compilation
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
CALL to ORCSDAY date conversion subprogram
Revision history with dated change log in comments
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in latin-1 but contains Japanese text that appears as mojibake (likely original encoding was EUC-JP or Shift-JIS). File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 57794 bytes total. The grpsys prefix on some lines may be a conditional compilation or group-system marker specific to the ORCA build system. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations, which is consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA style using PIC 9 fields.
